mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices (user_id, title, content, category, is_important, is_popup, view_count, publish_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{isImportant}, #{isPopup}, #{viewCount}, #{publishDate}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, is_important = #{isImportant}, is_popup = #{isPopup}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, user_id as userId, category, is_important as isImportant, is_popup as isPopup, view_count as viewCount, DATE_FORMAT(publish_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as publishDate, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt, DATE_FORMAT(expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as expireDate FROM notices WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id as userId, title, content, category, is_important as isImportant, is_popup as isPopup, view_count as viewCount, publish_date as publishDate, expire_date as expireDate, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM notices ORDER BY publish_date DESC
